'''World Statistics Day''' is an [[list of minor secular observances#October|international day]] to celebrate statistics.  Created by the [[United Nations Statistical Commission]],<ref>{{cite web|url=http://unstats.un.org/unsd/wsd/docs/PaulCheungOnWSD.pdf | access-date=2023-09-23| title=World Statistics Day|publisher=United Nations}}</ref> it was first celebrated on 20 October 2010, 20-10-2010.  The day is celebrated every five years.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.un.org/en/observances/statistics-day|title=World Statistics Day|website=www.un.org|language=en|access-date=2018-10-13}}</ref>

{{As of|2010}}, 103 countries celebrate a national Statistics Day, including 51 African countries that jointly celebrate African Statistics Day annually on 18 November.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://unstats.un.org/unsd/dnss/statistics_day/Statistics_Day.htm|title = United Nations Statistics Division}}</ref> India celebrates its statistics day on 29 June, the birthday of the statistician [[Prasanta Chandra Mahalanobis]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://pib.nic.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?relid=180211|title = "Statistics Day" will be celebrated on 29th June, 2018}}</ref>  The [[Royal Statistical Society]] in the UK also launched its ''getstats'' [[statistical literacy]] campaign on the same day at 20:10 (on 20 October 2010).<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.getstats.org.uk/ |title=Home |website=getstats.org.uk}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://statistics.unwto.org/content/world-statistics-day-0|title=World Statistics Day {{!}} Statistics|website=statistics.unwto.org|language=en|access-date=2018-10-13|archive-date=14 October 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181014053032/http://statistics.unwto.org/content/world-statistics-day-0|url-status=dead}}</ref>

On '''20 October 2025''', the world will celebrate '''United Nations World Statistics Day (WSD)''' under the theme: '''Driving change with quality statistics and data for everyone'''

For the first time ever, the '''UN Regional Commissions''' will unite to host a '''24-hour non-stop global webinar marathon''' — bringing voices, stories, and [[innovation]]s from every corner of the globe.

From '''Bangkok to Beirut, Addis Ababa to Geneva, and Santiago to New York''', the webinar will move with the sun, passing the virtual baton across time zones, showcasing how '''data is powering [[sustainable development]] and [[inclusion (disability rights)|inclusive]] [[decision-making]]'''.
